# DDL

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_references.py: run `just skill-references` instead of editing. -->

The statements `load` runs for each entity, in order. With `--overwrite`, it first drops the entity's
existing tables, in the same transaction that creates them again; the drops are left out here.

## PostgreSQL

Tables are created without keys, so the bulk load runs faster; the primary key and the indexes are built
once the rows are written (`--pg-index-workers` builds that many indexes at once), and with `--fk`, the
foreign keys after them. `--pg-unlogged` creates `UNLOGGED` tables. Tables go to the current schema, or the
one `--pg-schema` names. PostgreSQL names each index `<table>_<column>_idx`.

### artists

```sql
CREATE TABLE "artists" (
    "id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "data_quality" TEXT,
    "name" TEXT,
    "namevariations" TEXT[],
    "profile" TEXT,
    "realname" TEXT,
    "urls" TEXT[]
);
CREATE TABLE "artist_aliases" (
    "artist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "alias_id" INTEGER,
    "name" TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE "artist_groups" (
    "artist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "group_id" INTEGER,
    "name" TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE "artist_members" (
    "artist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "member_id" INTEGER,
    "name" TEXT
);
-- after the rows are written
ALTER TABLE "artists" ADD PRIMARY KEY ("id");
CREATE INDEX ON "artist_aliases" ("artist_id");
CREATE INDEX ON "artist_groups" ("artist_id");
CREATE INDEX ON "artist_members" ("artist_id");
-- with --fk
ALTER TABLE "artist_aliases" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("artist_id") REFERENCES "artists"("id");
ALTER TABLE "artist_groups" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("artist_id") REFERENCES "artists"("id");
ALTER TABLE "artist_members" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("artist_id") REFERENCES "artists"("id");
```

## SQLite

Tables are created with their primary key; the indexes are built once the rows are written. With `--fk`,
each table other than the root also declares its foreign key, shown in the comment after its link column.

### artists

```sql
CREATE TABLE "artists" (
    "id"                   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    "data_quality"         TEXT,
    "name"                 TEXT,
    "namevariations"       TEXT,
    "profile"              TEXT,
    "realname"             TEXT,
    "urls"                 TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE "artist_aliases" (
    "artist_id"            INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- with --fk: REFERENCES "artists"("id")
    "alias_id"             INTEGER,
    "name"                 TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE "artist_groups" (
    "artist_id"            INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- with --fk: REFERENCES "artists"("id")
    "group_id"             INTEGER,
    "name"                 TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE "artist_members" (
    "artist_id"            INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- with --fk: REFERENCES "artists"("id")
    "member_id"            INTEGER,
    "name"                 TEXT
);
-- after the rows are written
CREATE INDEX "artist_aliases_artist_id_idx" ON "artist_aliases"("artist_id");
CREATE INDEX "artist_groups_artist_id_idx" ON "artist_groups"("artist_id");
CREATE INDEX "artist_members_artist_id_idx" ON "artist_members"("artist_id");
```
